items.headline: Luster throws 2-point conversion in OT to give Ball State a wild 32-31 win over Bowling Green
items.description: — Keldric Luster found Alex Scherle for a 2-point conversion to lift Ball State to a dramatic 32-31 overtime win over Bowling Green on Saturday.
